name: Hiiragi Iwashi
source:
A 14-year-old housemaid comes to a 35-year-old shut-in game creator's house.

She is perfect in cleaning, laundry and cooking.

An easygoing story of these two and visitors.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE212901.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一名14岁的女佣来到一名35岁的游戏创作者家里。

她在清洁、洗衣和烹饪方面都很出色。

两人和访客的轻松故事。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE212901.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
